_comment: Who this instance aggregates. A SUBSCRIPTION, not a registry: there is no
authority and no global list, so nobody can inject themselves into your
aggregate. Adding a peer is a statement that you find their curation worth
role 'anchor' marks an everything-build. Anchors are fetched but do not vote
in adoption counts: an anchor including a PR is the absence of a curatorial
decision, not the presence of one.
